verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents an Editor API module for automating and extending the Editor, covering scene manipulation, asset management and custom tool integration, and positions it as the way to "change scenes from code." An official npm-published Editor MCP Server can also modify project data programmatically, and PCUI, the Editor's own UI library, is offered for building browser-based tools. missing for 10: a documented plugin loading/distribution mechanism inside the Editor, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the Editor API works in practice.
